description: This source file defines the class OpenIdApplicationManager<TApplication>, which manages OpenID applications, including retrieving applications by physical ID, managing roles, populating descriptors, and validation within the OrchardCore OpenId module.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationManager<TApplication>
classes.description: A generic manager class for handling OpenID applications, including role management, population, and validation.

methods.name: FindByPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an application by its physical identifier, either via store interface or fallback.

methods.name: GetPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Gets the physical ID associated with an application.

methods.name: GetRolesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with an application, either from store or properties.

methods.name: ListInRoleAsync
methods.description: Lists applications that are assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: SetRolesAsync
methods.description: Sets roles for an application, updating store properties or via store API.

methods.name: PopulateAsync
methods.description: Populates application data from a descriptor, including roles.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates an application, including checking for null or empty roles.
